Hindi/regional language content skills a plus Preferred Skills Experience collaborating directly with formulation chemists/R&D teams Familiarity with clean beauty, derma-cosmetic, or clinical skincare positioning Exposure to D2C/e-commerce content ecosystems (Shopify, Amazon A+ content, marketplace listings) Basic understanding of content tools (SEMrush/Ahrefs, CMS platforms, Grammarly, AI writing tools with editorial oversight) What We Offer Opportunity to shape the voice of a premium, science-led cosmetics brand Close collaboration with formulation and R&D experts Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards Growth path into Brand Content Lead / Editorial Manager roles

title: ASIGN - Content Editor
description:
Job Summary 
 Festivals From India is hiring on behalf of their client, ASIGN, for a Content Editor to create, edit, proofread, and format short- and long-form content for ASIGN's website, social media, campaigns, and brand communication. The role focuses on ensuring high-quality, accurate, engaging, and consistent content, while working closely with the Design, Marketing, and Product teams. The ideal candidate should have 1+ years of content/editing experience, excellent English and attention to detail, strong research skills, and familiarity with Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Essential Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Communications, Literature, Marketing, or a related field. Excellent command of written English, including grammar, vocabulary, sentence structure, and proofreading. Strong understanding of content writing, editing, formatting, and digital communication. A relevant content portfolio demonstrating short- and long-form writing is preferred. 
 
 Essential Experience 
 Minimum 1+ years of experience in Content Writing, Editing, Formatting, Copywriting, or a related role. Experience creating and editing content for websites, social media, blogs, campaigns, and marketing materials. Experience working closely with Design, Marketing, and Product teams to develop and publish content. Hands-on experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or other Generative AI tools for content ideation, drafting, editing, and research. Experience with content management/review tools, fact-checking, and quality control is preferred. 
 
 Key Personal Attributes & Skills 
 Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills. Strong attention to detail, grammar, vocabulary, and language proficiency. Creative and able to develop clear, engaging, and impactful copy. Strong research and fact-checking abilities. Ability to maintain a consistent brand tone and voice across different platforms. Good understanding of digital and social media content. Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments. Collaborative and comfortable working with cross-functional teams. Adaptable, curious, and willing to learn and use AI and content tools effectively. Basic understanding of SEO and content marketing is an advantage.
